items.question: What claim about the scope of suffering requires that beings be tormented across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A fixed count of womb-diagrams is specified here.
Beings are said to undergo torment within them.
The scale of that count sets the extent of the stated affliction.
items.inference: The affliction extends to beings held within all eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Whether the count is literal or enumerative remains unclear.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
